title: A 5% Selloff? No Big Deal for Korea's AI-Heavy Benchmark Index
title_zh: 5% 的抛售？韩国人工智能重磅基准指数没什么大不了的
summary: South Korea's tech-heavy benchmark index closed 5.5% lower today. Yawn. It was only the sixth-worst day of 2026. The Kospi Composite is still up 94% this year, powered by a handful of AI-related stocks.
summary_zh: 韩国以科技股为主的基准指数今天收盘下跌 5.5%。打哈欠。这只是 2026 年表现第六差的一天。在少数人工智能相关股票的推动下，Kospi 综合指数今年仍上涨 94%。

title: Bodycote Shares Fall After Apollo Pulls Back on Making Firm $2 Billion Takeover Offer
title_zh: Apollo 撤回 20 亿美元收购要约后 Bodycote 股价下跌
summary: Shares in  Bodycote  fell on Friday after  Apollo  Global Management said it doesn’t intend to make a firm takeover offer, ending discussions over a 1.52 billion-pound ($2.04 billion) proposal.
summary_zh: 周五，阿波罗全球管理公司表示不打算提出明确的收购要约，结束了有关 15.2 亿英镑（20.4 亿美元）提案的讨论后，Bodycote 的股价下跌。

title: Amazon Leans Into AI With Pinterest Deal And Anthropic IPO Upside
title_zh: 亚马逊通过 Pinterest 交易和 Anthropic IPO 优势进军人工智能
summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) signs a US$4b cloud services agreement with Pinterest to expand AI infrastructure on AWS. The Pinterest deal is described as the largest infrastructure commitment in Pinterest's history, focused on AI, cloud, and chip utilization.
summary_zh: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) 与 Pinterest 签署了价值 40 亿美元的云服务协议，以扩展 AWS 上的人工智能基础设施。 Pinterest 交易被描述为 Pinterest 历史上最大的基础设施承诺，重点关注人工智能、云和芯片利用。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
